concepts.summary: Jet sweep to the open side with 16-17 run action going the other way. It brings two blockers to the play side.
concepts.qb: Snap it when the motion man reaches the B gap. Open to the jet runner, then carry on with the mid zone fake away from the sweep.
concepts.hb: Toes at 7.5 yards. Lateral open step and track the C gap. Fake 17-16.

positions.OL: Targets number 2 counting in from the sideline. The playside tackle blocks toward the sweep when a two-point stance player is on that side.
positions.Z: On the cards one playside receiver arcs to number 2 and the other blocks the widest, number 1.
positions.Y: Labeled Gang, Single or B on the cards depending on the front.

alerts: Possible Push call to the nickel.
Be ready for the linebackers to slide, and for a straighten up call.
A two-point stance player on the sweep side means reach.

concepts.summary: Jet sweep to the open side with 16-17 run action the other way, run from 3x1. It brings one blocker to the play side. One tells the playside receiver to block the most dangerous man.
concepts.qb: Snap it when the motion man reaches the B gap. Open to the jet runner, then carry on with the mid zone fake away from the sweep.
concepts.hb: Toes at 7.5 yards. Lateral open step and track the C gap. Fake 17-16.

positions.OL: Targets number 2 counting in from the sideline. The playside tackle blocks toward the sweep when a two-point stance player is on that side.
positions.X: The lone playside receiver on One: blocks the most dangerous man by the 8-9 rule.

alerts: Possible Push call to the nickel.
Be ready for the linebackers to slide.

concepts.summary: Jet sweep to a closed side with 17-16 run action the other way. It brings two blockers to the play side.
concepts.qb: Snap it when the motion man reaches the B gap. Open to the jet runner, then carry on with the mid zone fake away from the sweep. The sweep runner takes the ball at 3.5 to 4 yards deep and bows a little after the mesh.

positions.Y: Blocks the linebacker force player. Labeled Single, Mob or Double on the cards.
positions.Z: On the cards one playside receiver arcs to number 2 and the other blocks the widest, number 1.

alerts: Be ready for the linebackers to slide.
Perimeter rule on the cards is 6-7 MDM or 8-9 MDM depending on the set.

concepts.summary: Full flow jet sweep to the strong side.
concepts.qb: Snap it when the motion man reaches the B gap. Open away from the sweep, hand to the sweep runner at 4 yards, then carry on with the Wanda fake.
concepts.criteria: Check it against playside outside pressure.
alerts: Perimeter rule on the cards is 8-9 MDM.
